sections.title: Shrub and flowers
sections.text: Teucrium fruticans is an evergreen Mediterranean shrub, usually 1–1.5 m tall and wide in cultivation. Its white-hairy stems bear small leaves that are dark green above and pale beneath. Light-blue flowers, about 2.5 cm long, appear in summer. The plate's silvery foliage and blue flowers fit these features.

sections.title: Food and toxicity
sections.text: The Royal Horticultural Society classifies this plant as harmful if eaten. No edible parts are established in the sources consulted; do not treat it as a culinary germander.

sections.title: Habitat and garden use
sections.text: This species is native to the Mediterranean region and grows as a bushy evergreen shrub. It is cultivated ornamentally and tolerates coastal conditions.
